title: 2023 AMC 12A Problem 6
statement: Points \(A\) and \(B\) lie on the graph of \(y=\log_2 x.\) The midpoint of \(\overline{AB}\) is \((6,2).\) What is the positive difference between the \(x\)-coordinates of \(A\) and \(B?\)

solutions.text:
Let the \(x\)-coordinates be \(x_1\) and \(x_2.\) The midpoint gives \(x_1+x_2=12,\) and the average of the \(y\)-values gives \(\log_2 x_1+\log_2 x_2=4,\) so \(x_1x_2=2^4=16.\)

Then \[ \begin{gathered} |x_1-x_2|\\ {}=\sqrt{(x_1+x_2)^2-4x_1x_2}\\ {}=\sqrt{144-64}\\ {}=\sqrt{80}\\ {}=4\sqrt5. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The \(y\)-coordinates average to \(2,\) so \(\log_2 x_1+\log_2 x_2=4,\) giving \(x_1x_2=16\)
